text: Stereo joint generation: L+R frames with an epipolar other-eye lookup
description: Generate from 2 VR frames: parallax gives edges and 3D understanding. Each pixel reads the other eye at the depth-implied disparity, so the eyes can't drift apart. An alternative is to generate one eye and warp it to the other.

status.comment: Done: cross-eye splat (each eye gets half of the other eye's previous state, checkerboard), stereo training with a second eye and a disagreement loss (train.stereo). Not done: an explicit epipolar other-eye lookup in the net's inputs.
